about: Differences between the folded build and the v1.0.11 reference that scripts/fold/equivalence.py reports and that are explained. Each entry quotes the exact difference line; anything not listed fails.

deltas.difference: DKRPortGame: runtime-recomp/src/game/game_main.cpp: include dirs lost ['runtime-recomp/src'] extra []
deltas.reason: A layer re-added the parent of game_main.cpp's staged directory (prior/..). No include in the TU or its headers resolves through runtime-recomp/src: dropping it from the reference include path leaves all 233 resolved includes unchanged.
The parent of a layer's generated stage directory (prior/..). No include in the TU or its headers resolves through it: dropping it leaves all 166 resolved includes unchanged.

deltas.difference: DKRPortGame: runtime-recomp/src/game/runtime_ui.cpp: include dirs lost ['<build>/generated'] extra []
deltas.reason: The parent of a layer's generated stage directory (prior/..). No include in the TU or its headers resolves through it: dropping it leaves all 842 resolved includes unchanged.

deltas.difference: DKRPortGame: runtime-recomp/src/game/rt64_renderer.cpp: object sections differ: data .eh_frame, data .group
deltas.reason: Header variant mobile_graphics_preset.hpp (PR 68): its new inline helpers instantiate GraphicsConfig's destructor earlier, so that COMDAT is emitted first. All 79 sections exist on both sides and every text section and relocation is identical; only the unwind-table entry order (.eh_frame) and the COMDAT group section indices (.group) follow the new emission order.

deltas.difference: DKRPortGame: link order moved ['-lm', 'libDKRCameraSceneV77.a', 'libDKRCameraSceneV80.a'], everything else in order
deltas.reason: The game's TUs compile in the DKRPortGameCore object library (so host builds without a payload compile them), and DKR-R links the core's libraries LINK_ONLY. CMake now places DKRCameraPresentation's private dependencies (the two camera scene kernels and libm) at their first transitive occurrence instead of the end. They still follow DKRCameraPresentation, their only user, and every other library keeps its position.

The achievements and all-player-detail layers gave their hooked copy the payload directory and its parent (prior/..) as per-source include directories, which only let their absolute funcs.h/imports.h includes resolve. The guest-hooks copy reaches the same headers through the payload target's own include path; level 2 finds the preprocessed TU token-identical.
